Sample Youth Apprenticeship Allowance

Ministry of Example Skills

Benefit: Stipend of Rs 6,000 per month for 12 months during apprenticeship.

Who can apply: Young people between 18 and 35 years of age whose annual family income is not more than Rs 3,00,000. The candidate must have passed Class 12 and must belong to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe.

Documents: Aadhaar card, Class 12 marksheet, Caste certificate.

Apply online through the apprenticeship portal.
